| Deploy on table (only at start of game). You may not deploy Jedi with 'communing' in game text. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Communing]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Communing (Errata)]] shares the [[Communing]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
